# South Carolina Code of Laws Title 35 - SECURITIES CHAPTER 1 South Carolina Uniform Securities Act of 2005 Editor's Note The South Carolina Uniform Securities Act of 2005 replaced former Chapter 1, Uniform Securities, with a new Chapter 1, effective January 1, 2006, numbered in conformity with the Uniform Securities Act. The new chapter includes Official and South Carolina Reporters comments linking the old and new chapters. Copyright © 2026 SOUTH CAROLINA SENATE. South Carolina Reporters' Comments contained herein may not be reproduced in whole or in part in any form or for inclusion in any material which is offered for sale without the express written permission of the Clerk of the South Carolina Senate.
